description: Järnvägsdata - Trumma is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trafikverket. Med trummor avses sådana konstruktioner vars diameter/bredd understiger 2 m. Konstruktioner med diameter/bredd/spännvidd 2 m eller mer betraktas som broar. Antal vattengångar Anger om trumman är en enkel-, dubbel- eller trippeltrumma. Om trumman har ett rör så skall antal vattengångar vara 1, om den har två rör så skall antalet vattengångar vara 2 osv. Coverage: Trafikverket. The publisher named on the listing is Trafikverket. Its keywords include StJDB. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, WMS_XML. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
